title: Interest on Metering Service Fast-Meter Refunds
content:
Interest on a **Metering Service** fast-meter refund turns on the number of bills the refund counts back from the company test date.

| Bills counted back from the company test date | Refund interest rate |
|---|---|
| 12 or more (the full-interest number) | 4.17 percent (0.0417) |
| At least 3 (the half-interest number) and fewer than 12 | One half of 4.17 percent, that is 2.085 percent |
| Fewer than 3 | No refund interest |

**Clause.** Where the fast-meter refund counts back at least the full-interest number of 12 bills, the refund interest rate is the refund interest rate of 4.17 percent. Where it covers at least the half-interest number of 3 bills but fewer than 12, the refund interest rate is one half of the refund interest rate. In every other case there is no refund interest.

**Amount.** The refund interest is the corrected charges times the fast-meter error factor, rounded to the cent, times the refund interest rate, times the number of bills counted back from the company test date divided by 24, which is simple interest for half the counted-back period in years, rounded to the cent. Only the bills counted back from the company test date are counted; a bill whose billing period ended after the company test date is not.

## Worked figures (hypothetical, corrected charges times the error factor, rounded, of 61.17)

| Bills counted back | Rate | Interest |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | 4.17 percent | 61.17 times 0.0417 times 12 divided by 24 is 1.28 |
| 6 | 2.085 percent | 61.17 times 0.02085 times 6 divided by 24 is 0.32 |
| 3 | 2.085 percent | 61.17 times 0.02085 times 3 divided by 24 is 0.16 |
| 2 | None | 0.00 |
| 11 | 2.085 percent | 61.17 times 0.02085 times 11 divided by 24 is 0.58 |
